result.rationale: The task requires preserving the authorization sentence byte-for-byte and redacting only the secret value. Candidate A does this correctly: it drops the 'Source:' label (which is not part of the preserved sentence) and produces a clean one-line REWRITE that matches the required authorization sentence exactly. Candidate B includes 'Source:' in the REWRITE line, which was not part of the byte-for-byte preserved authorization sentence and introduces extraneous text not in the original preserved sentence. Neither response has a critical security issue — both correctly redact only the secret value and preserve the authorization scope — but A more faithfully follows the format and preservation requirements.
